profile.title: Your expert profile
profile.intro: Clients see this profile next to every service you offer. Everything you enter is shown as self-reported until Greco verifies it.
profile.previewNote: Preview: only you and Greco staff can see this page until your profile is approved.

sections.addressDescription: Your public profile address. Changing it breaks links you've already shared.
sections.photoDescription: A clear photo of you, or your agency's logo. JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 4 MB.
sections.agencyDescription: Shown on your profile. Legal name and registration number stay private.
sections.skillsDescription: Choose at least 3. They decide where you appear in search and recommendations.
sections.languagesDescription: Languages you can work in with clients.
sections.linksDescription: Your website, GitHub, LinkedIn or other public work. Links are shown as provided, not verified.

fields.displayNameHint: Your name or your agency's name.
fields.headline: Headline
fields.headlineHint: One line about what you do, for example "Voice agents for clinics and service businesses".
fields.bioHint: At least 100 characters. What you do, for whom, and how you work. Don't include contact details: all communication stays on Greco.
fields.availabilityNoteHint: For example "Taking new projects from March".
fields.rateHint: Shown as a guide only. Service prices are set on each service.
fields.privateHint: Private. Used for verification and invoices, never shown publicly.

checklist.title: Before you submit
checklist.headline: Add a headline (at least 10 characters)
checklist.bio: Write an about section (at least 100 characters)
checklist.skills: Choose at least 3 skills or technologies

profile.submitHint: Greco checks every new profile before it goes public.

suggest.title: Can't find a skill?
suggest.description: Suggest it and Greco will add it to the list.
suggest.name: Name

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.intro: Case studies of work you've done. They appear on your profile marked as self-reported.
portfolio.empty: No case studies yet. Add one to show clients the problems you've solved.
portfolio.deleteConfirm: Delete this case study? This can't be undone.

fields.title: Title
fields.summaryHint: One or two sentences shown on your profile.
fields.resultsHint: Only claims you can back up. Clients may ask for evidence.
fields.clientNameHint: Only with the client's permission. Leave empty to keep it anonymous.
fields.imagesHint: Screenshots or diagrams, up to 8. Remove client data before uploading.
fields.caption: Caption

services.title: Services
services.intro: Fixed-scope services clients can buy directly. Each service is reviewed before it goes live.
services.empty: You haven't created any services yet.
